probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently Amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests and data records from a plurality of creditors to file __proof of claim documents__ with a plurality of different bankruptcy __courts__;
automatically generating the __proof of claim documents__ with the received data records, wherein the __proof of claim documents__ are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy __courts__; and
batch filing the __proof of claim documents__ with the different bankruptcy __courts__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the different bankruptcy __courts__ are different courts with different filing system configurations.

6. (Currently Amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests from a plurality of creditors to file proofs of claims for debts owed by debtors to the creditors with a plurality of different bankruptcy __courts__, wherein each request includes a data record for generating a proof of claim;
automatically generating the proofs of claims with the received data records, wherein the proofs of claims are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy __courts__; and
batch filing the proofs of claims with the different bankruptcy __courts__.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 wherein the different bankruptcy __courts__ are different bankruptcy courts having different filing system configurations.

8. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising sending bankruptcy notification messages to the plurality of creditors, wherein the bankruptcy notification messages notify the creditors that various debtors have filed for bankruptcy __and include instructions for filing proofs of claims__.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests from the plurality of creditors comprises receiving the requests using a secure file transfer protocol __for transmitting proof of claim data__.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests comprises receiving requests via a Web site __configured for proof of claim submissions__.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 where batch filing comprises aggregating the proofs of claims and filing the proofs of claims in a batch mode at least once per day __with bankruptcy courts__.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising:
generating a report __regarding filed proofs of claims__; and
sending the report to a particular creditor.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises enabling a user to request the report using a Web site __for proof of claim status__.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises generating an aging report specifying a reason some proofs of claims have not been filed __with bankruptcy courts__.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 further comprising receiving a filing receipt for a filed proof of claim __from a bankruptcy court__.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 wherein batch filing is performed by a server computer __configured to interface with bankruptcy court filing systems__.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising validating the data record __for proof of claim requirements__.
